speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consultation. I am Dr. Agent; you are a neonate presenting with seizures and lethargy three days after birth. To begin my assessment, has your mother experienced any infections, fever, or vaginal bleeding during your pregnancy or delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE) secondary to chorioamnionitis and low Apgar scores; consider secondary sepsis or intraventricular hemorrhage.

REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, CBC_with_Diff, Electrolytes, Glucose, Coagulation_Panel, Head_Cranial_Ultrasound.
REQUEST IMAGES: Head_CT_without_contrast.
